content: {"id":"d23ea901-88ec-42a8-9c31-1614536d663b","type":"https://serlo.org/editor","variant":"serlo-org","domainOrigin":"serlo.org","version":2,"editorVersion":"0.22.0","dateModified":"2025-02-26T18:25:40.708Z","document":{"plugin":"course","state":{"content":{"plugin":"rows","state":[]},"pages":[{"content":{"plugin":"rows","state":[{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"h","children":[{"text":"Inhalt des Kurses:"}],"level":3}],"id":"2e61191b-7852-4dbe-a99e-d569fcd283ec"},{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Du lernst an dem Beispiel einer Pizza, wie du die "},{"text":"Kreisfläche bestimmen","strong":true},{"text":" kannst."}]}],"id":"06d51cb7-71f5-4de7-8e06-a8420b3679b6"},{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"h","children":[{"text":"Vorkenntnisse:"}],"level":3}],"id":"bb3ec6f4-a84b-4673-95ed-322667f16449"},{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Du solltest die "},{"text":"Grundbegriffe eines Kreises","strong":true},{"text":" kennen und wissen, wie man den "},{"text":"Umfang vom Kreis","strong":true},{"text":" berechnet."}]}],"id":"0ed48551-da54-4f0f-a53c-7599b25e9b47"},{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"h","children":[{"text":"Dauer: "}],"level":3}],"id":"9f1d4ee6-f37d-4e3c-833a-5025e4d710bd"},{"plugin":"text","state":[{"type":"p","children":[{"text":"Der Kurs dauert "},{"text":"ungefähr 1,5 Stunden","strong":true},{"text":" (Wenn du die Übungsaufgaben alle selbstständig lösen möchtest)."}]}],"id":"a77f97a0-7112-4195-95e7-eac91573c20c"}],"id":"304787c7-5488-4a92-8d6f-670ebe2d2774"},"id":"276736-course-page","title":"Übersicht"}]},"id":"e1fb7649-f654-41b1-b764-c0bf50e007aa"}}
